title: Patagonia: Towers Trekking Expedition
summary: Torres del Paine without the crowds at the viewpoints — timed hikes with a certified guide, a private refugio, and weather-buffer days built in on purpose.
highlights: The Torres del Paine base trek

itinerary.title: Arrive in Puerto Natales
itinerary.description: A transfer into the park with your first real look at the towers.

itinerary.title: Base trek
itinerary.description: The park's signature hike, timed with a certified guide to miss the worst crowds.

itinerary.title: French Valley
itinerary.description: Hanging glaciers and avalanche thunder from a trail most day-trippers never reach.

itinerary.title: Grey Glacier
itinerary.description: By boat, close enough to hear the ice moving.

itinerary.title: Estancia day
itinerary.description: A working sheep ranch, ridden the way the gauchos actually ride it.

itinerary.title: Weather-buffer day
itinerary.description: Built in on purpose — Patagonia sets the schedule, not the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Condor lookout
itinerary.description: A short, steep climb for one of the park's best views, before the day tours arrive.

itinerary.title: Asado dinner
itinerary.description: Patagonian lamb, slow-cooked, with the guide who's walked you through the park.

itinerary.title: Depart the park
itinerary.description: A final morning view of the towers before the drive back to Puerto Natales.

included: 8 nights across a boutique lodge & private refugio
A certified mountain guide for every hike
Daily breakfast, 5 dinners including the asado
All ground transfers within the park
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
